programme.title: The Shell Seekers
programme.desc: Angela Lansbury is a widow searching for a meaning to her life in this teleplay adapted from Rosamunde Pilcher's novel. Olivia: Patricia Hodge. Nancy: Anna Carteret. Noel: Christopher Bowen. Antonia: Sophie Ward. Richard: Sam Wanamaker. Danus: Mark Lewis Jones. Cosmo: Denis Quilley. Dolly: Irene Worth. Roy: Michael Gough. George: John Rowe. Filmed in England and Spain.

programme.title: Woman of the House
programme.desc: A woman who feels nostalgic about her college sorority days takes a job as a house mother to her former chapter. Along with bringing out the best in the girls, she helps to turn the chapter around with the help of the charming Dean of Student Affairs.

programme.title: Love's Abiding Joy
programme.desc: In this drama based on the fourth book in Janette Oke's best-selling "Love Comes Softly" series, Missie and Willie LaHaye (Erin Cottrell, Logan Bartholomew) get accustomed to rugged frontier life, but tragedy threatens to shake up their stable family. Michael Landon Jr. directed.

programme.title: Bad Date Chronicles
programme.desc: Leigh runs the popular website 'Bad Date Chronicles' where daters can go to anonymously post horrible date experiences. When rival blogger Conner becomes the subject of one of her posts, they agree to date each other in order to prove which one is actually a bad dater.

programme.title: Fixing Pete
programme.desc: A fashion columnist (Brooke Burns) receives an assignment to make over a sloppy sportswriter (Dylan Bruno). As the pair spend time together, they learn from each other and sparks begin to fly. But romantic complications threaten to keep them apart. Directed by Michael Grossman.

programme.title: A Stranger's Heart
programme.desc: Samantha Mathis plays Callie, the recipient of a long-awaited heart transplant whose cynical attitude dissipates as she longs for a connection with her donor's orphaned daughter. Peter Dobson plays Callie's love interest and fellow transplant recipient, but it's Thomas Kopache who steals the show as her perennially grieving widowed father. Andy Wolk directed.

programme.title: Rock the House
programme.desc: A busy lawyer (Jack Coleman) struggles to make time for his teen daughter (Cassi Thomson), and their relationship suffers. But when the man reconnects with his high-school bandmates, he sees positive changes in everyone. Directed by Ernie Barbarash.

programme.title: Late Bloomer
programme.desc: Botanist Jenny fled her small town and cruel high school couple Shane and Allison to track rare flowers around the globe. Now back, she's shocked to find Shane has become a teacher and even more surprised when he's determined to make it up to her.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: Neighbors form an unusual arrangement to share custody of a dog, and the pair soon find themselves falling for one another.

programme.title: Honeymoon for One
programme.desc: A Los Angeles advertising exec travels to Ireland alone for her honeymoon after breaking things off with her dishonest fiancé. While abroad, she develops a connection with a local estate manager, but a conflict involving the woman's business threatens the budding romance.

programme.title: A Son's Promise
programme.desc: Rick Schroder as the eldest of seven brothers, battling to keep his siblings together. Filmed in Georgia. Dorothy: Veronica Cartwright. Weston: Boyd Gaines. Paw Paw: Donald Moffat. Wayne: David Andrews. Tommy: Andrew Lowery. Charles: Stephen Dorff. Renolds: Ken Strong. Judge: Danny Nelson. David: Ryan Marshall.

programme.title: Playing Father
programme.desc: A jazz musician takes a teaching gig at a struggling school and mentors a talented but troubled student. As he helps the teen confront problems at home and school, he also begins to focus on healing his relationship with his own distant son.

programme.title: Do I Say I Do?
programme.desc: Author Jessica Bender is forced to work with her former boyfriend and editor Mike Pryce. During this association, the two ex begin to realize that the spark of their love is not yet completely extinguished.

programme.title: Hidden Places

programme.title: Easy Heart

programme.desc: Neighbors form an unusual arrangement to share custody of a dog, and the pair soon find themselves falling for one another.

programme.title: The Cabin
programme.desc: A divorced mom (Lea Thompson) and her kids are forced to bunk with a single dad (Steven Brand) and his two children after a cabin mix-up at a resort in Scotland. Though the adults initially clash, they decide to join forces to compete in a sporting event at the resort, and it's not long before sparks start to fly. Directed by Brian Trenchard-Smith.

programme.title: Cupid, Inc.
programme.desc: A talk-show host receives a visit from a mysterious love expert, who promises he'll reveal her true love to her if she first helps other couples find each other. Her matchmaking efforts don't go smoothly, however, and she begins to question her task.

programme.title: My George
programme.desc: A struggling writer pens a romance novel, and then she searches for an ideal boyfriend like the one in her book to help her agent with publicity. Before long, she meets a charming real-estate agent and reconnects with an old high-school friend.
